title: Compact credential handshake and checkpointed stream ergonomics for Py/TS/Go SDKs
author: Iris Valdez
description: Motivation: reduce auth handshake allocations across hot streaming paths and add a small ergonomic API for checkpointed/resumable streams across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs. This PR introduces a compact credential handshake wire format (opt-in) that trims per-request credential headers and a stream checkpoint primitive that lets consumers persist resume tokens and restart long-lived streams with deterministic backoff. Design summary: 1) compact_auth: an opt-in exchange that consolidates token + ephemeral metadata into a single short-lived envelope; 2) Stream.checkpoint() and Stream.resume(checkpoint_token) surface across SDKs with identical semantics; 3) new retry presets: streaming_checkpoint_safe and handshake_light that tune hedged and backoff behavior for resumable streams; 4) small ergonomics: iterator helpers (py: resume_from, ts: fromCheckpoint, go: ResumeFrom) and examples. The description below lists commits, high-level file changes, review notes, CI results, and migration notes. Checklist: [x] API proposals discussed in weekly SDK sync (ENG-10234); [x] spec doc updated; [x] unit+integration tests for all three SDKs; [x] changelogs and migration guidance added. Backwards compatibility: the compact handshake is guarded behind a flag and falls back to the legacy header flow for older servers; checkpointed streams are additive and do not change existing streaming semantics when unused. Migration: SDK consumers can opt into compact_auth via client config {use_compact_auth:true} and adopt Stream.resume by storing checkpoint_token from Stream.checkpoint(). Commit summary: - 1a2b3c4: introduce compact_auth transport and envelope encoding across transports - 2d3e4f5: add Stream.checkpoint/resume APIs + examples for py/ts/go - 3f4g5h6: add retry profiles and unit tests - 4i5j6k7: bump versions (py 1.9.0, ts 1.11.0, go v1.6.2) - 5l6m7n8: docs and migration guide updates Changed files (high level): ["sdk/python/redwood/session/compact_auth.py","sdk/python/redwood/streaming/checkpoint.py","sdk/python/tests/test_checkpoint.py","sdk/typescript/src/compactAuth.ts","sdk/typescript/src/stream/checkpoint.ts","sdk/typescript/tests/checkpoint.spec.ts","sdk/go/cred/compact.go","sdk/go/stream/checkpoint.go","docs/sdk/checkpointed-streams.md"]. Small illustrative snippet (compact_auth envelope schematic): {env_v:1,token_crc:0x1f2e,meta_len:23,payload:base64(...)}. Review conversation summary: Aaron: asked for clarity on failure modes when checkpoint token is stale; response added deterministic error class StreamCheckpointStale and a short circuit code path to force a full reconnect; Priya: requested a smaller surface for TypeScript resume helpers (we replaced fromCheckpoint with fromCheckpointUnsafe then reverted; final names are fromCheckpoint and fromCheckpointSafe); Diego requested stricter unit tests around hedged retry interaction with resume; tests added and flaky timeout reduced. CI: initial run showed an intermittent test timeout in ts checkpoint spec; reran and all green. Merge outcome: merged via squash-merge on 2024-09-20 with commit message summarizing the handshake and checkpoint primitives. Release notes: "Add opt-in compact credential handshake to reduce auth overhead on hot streaming paths; add Stream.checkpoint() and Stream.resume(token) helpers in Python/TypeScript/Go; new retry presets streaming_checkpoint_safe and handshake_light; SDK bumps: python 1.9.0, typescript 1.11.0, go v1.6.2." Breaking change: false; Additional notes: documented edge cases and server compatibility matrix in docs/sdk/checkpointed-streams.md; e2e matrix test added to perf-canary job to assert no regressions in 95th percentile latency when compact_auth is toggled.
